newsitem.title: GERMANY: MOTORCYCLING-CRIVILLE EXPECTED TO RETURN NEXT MONTH.
newsitem.headline: MOTORCYCLING-CRIVILLE EXPECTED TO RETURN NEXT MONTH.

text.p: Spaniard Alex Criville, who sustained severe hand injuries in a high-speed crash last month, is expected to return to racing next month, one of his sponsors said on Saturday.

Honda rider Criville, who needed several skin grafts after his accident during qualifying for the Dutch Grand Prix in Assen, should be back in action either for the British Grand Prix at Donington on August 17 or the race on August 31 in Brno, in the Czech Republic, the sponsor said.

Criville, who left hospital shortly after the San Marino Grand Prix at Imola two weeks ago, was second in the world championship standings on 102 points, behind Australian team mate Michael Doohan on 195, before Sunday's German Grand Prix at Nuerburgring.
The Spaniard will need corrective surgery on a damaged tendon after the season, his sponsor added.
